2.w: “Command the Israelites: ‘With regard to my offering, be sure to offer my food for my offering made by fire, as a pleasing aroma to me at its appointed time.’

3.w: You will say to them, ‘This is the offering made by fire that you must offer to the Lord: two unblemished lambs one year old each day for a continual burnt offering.

4.w: The first lamb you must offer in the morning, and the second lamb you must offer in the late afternoon,

5.w: with one-tenth of an ephah of finely ground flour as a grain offering mixed with one-quarter of a hin of pressed olive oil.

6.w: It is a continual burnt offering that was instituted on Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

7.w: “‘And its drink offering must be one-quarter of a hin for each lamb. You must pour out the strong drink as a drink offering to the Lord in the Holy Place.

8.w: And the second lamb you must offer in the late afternoon; just as you offered the grain offering and drink offering in the morning, you must offer it as an offering made by fire, as a pleasing aroma to the Lord.

9.w: “‘On the Sabbath day, you must offer two unblemished lambs a year old, and two-tenths of an ephah of finely ground flour as a grain offering, mixed with olive oil, along with its drink offering.

10.w: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

11.w: “‘On the first day of each month you must offer as a burnt offering to the Lord two young bulls, one ram, and seven unblemished lambs a year old,

12.w: with three-tenths of an ephah of finely ground flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering for each bull, and two-tenths of an ephah of finely ground flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering for the ram,

13.w: and one-tenth of an ephah of finely ground flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering for a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

14.w: For their drink offerings, include half a hin of wine with each bull, one-third of a hin for the ram, and one-fourth of a hin for each lamb. This is the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year.

15.w: And one male goat must be offered to the Lord as a purification offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

16.w: “‘On the fourteenth day of the first month is the Lord’s Passover.

17.w: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the festival. For seven days bread made without yeast must be eaten.

18.w: And on the first day there is to be a holy assembly; you must do no ordinary work on it.

19.w: “‘But you must offer to the Lord an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs one year old; they must all be unblemished.

20.w: And their grain offering is to be of finely ground flour mixed with olive oil. For each bull you must offer three-tenths of an ephah, and two-tenths for the ram.

21.w: For each of the seven lambs you are to offer one-tenth of an ephah,

22.w: as well as one goat for a purification offering, to make atonement for you.

23.w: You must offer these in addition to the burnt offering in the morning that is for a continual burnt offering.

24.w: In this manner you must offer daily throughout the seven days the food of the sacrifice made by fire as a sweet aroma to the Lord. It is to be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

25.w: On the seventh day you are to have a holy assembly, you must do no regular work.

26.w: “‘Also, on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new grain offering to the Lord during your Feast of Weeks, you are to have a holy assembly. You must do no ordinary work.

27.w: But you must offer as the burnt offering, as a sweet aroma to the Lord, two young bulls, one ram, seven lambs one year old,

28.w: with their grain offering of finely ground flour mixed with olive oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,

29.w: with one-tenth for each of the seven lambs,

30.w: as well as one male goat to make an atonement for you.

31.w: You are to offer them with their drink offerings in addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering—they must be unblemished.
